subject: Data Engineering
title: Grain: The Foundation of a Fact Table
description: One-minute skill: Grain: The Foundation of a Fact Table.

hook.text: A sales table shows $1M in revenue. But is that per order, per line item, or per day? Grain matters.

buildup.text: Grain defines the level of detail in a fact table — one row per what, exactly?

discovery.text: A grain of 'one row per order line item per day' tells you exactly what each number represents.

twist.text: Mixing grains in one table — daily and monthly rows together — produces nonsensical aggregations.

climax.text: Declaring the grain first is the most important decision in dimensional modeling.

punchline.text: Define the grain wrong and every number lies.

quiz.question: What does 'grain' define in a fact table?
options: The level of detail each row represents
The number of columns in the table
